operations.name: AuditLog.list_files
operations.doc: The audit log's files: name, first and last record time, record count, size and digest.

operations.name: AuditLog.read
operations.doc: The records of one audit file that match `params`, in the caller's namespace.

operations.name: AuditLog.rotate
operations.doc: Close the current audit file and start a new one.

operations.name: AuditLog.stats
operations.doc: The audit log's operational snapshot.

operations.name: AuditLog.tail
operations.doc: Subscribe the calling process to every audit record as it is written.

operations.name: AuditLog.unsubscribe
operations.doc: Undo a `tail/2`.

operations.name: Controller.boot_await
operations.doc: Wait until the readiness verdict is `:ready`, or `timeout_ms` passes.

args.name: timeout_ms
args.doc: How long to wait, in milliseconds.

operations.name: Controller.boot_status
operations.doc: The readiness verdict and every precondition behind it, then each running namespace's recovery state and persistent-registry row count.

operations.name: Controller.cluster_status
operations.doc: The cluster as `namespace` sees it: its nodes, each one's relay count and recovery state, the unplaced relays and the relays' health.

operations.name: Controller.durability_backend
operations.doc: The durability backend this controller is configured for.

operations.name: Controller.durability_breaches
operations.doc: The durability breaches recorded since the controller started.

operations.name: Controller.durability_posture
operations.doc: Whether durable state is shipped to a remote tier or stays local.

operations.name: Controller.durability_status
operations.doc: The durability shipper's own status.

operations.name: Controller.hub_id
operations.doc: The hub id for `namespace`, as this controller composes it.

operations.name: Controller.liveness_counters
operations.doc: Every data-plane liveness counter this node holds.

operations.name: Controller.mem_top
operations.doc: One snapshot of the controller's memory hot spots.

operations.name: Controller.recovery_per_node
operations.doc: Each node's recovery state for `namespace`, keyed by node.

operations.name: Controller.recovery_state
operations.doc: One hub's recovery state, by hub id.

operations.name: Controller.shutdown_status
operations.doc: Where the graceful shutdown sequence has reached.

operations.name: Controller.status
operations.doc: The controller's status: its node, its shutdown state and settings, its durability, its state root and the folder file plugins may use.

operations.name: Controller.stop
operations.doc: Drain this controller and stop it.

operations.name: Dlq.drop
operations.doc: Discard a parked entry and its payload.

operations.name: Dlq.get
operations.doc: One entry and its payload bytes, or `nil` bytes when it carries none.

operations.name: Dlq.list
operations.doc: Parked entries, nearest-to-expiry first; `nil` for every class.

args.name: relay_class
args.doc: The relay whose entries to read; every relay when absent.

operations.name: Dlq.replay
operations.doc: Re-dispatch a parked payload to its relay through the ordinary input path.

operations.name: Dlq.stats
operations.doc: Entry and byte counts per parked tasklet.

operations.name: Dlq.tasklets
operations.doc: The `{relay_class, tasklet_id}` pairs that hold parked entries.

args.name: relay_class
args.doc: The relay whose entries to read; every relay when absent.

operations.name: Fleet.factories
operations.doc: The factories declared in `namespace`.

operations.name: Fleet.hub_nodes
operations.doc: The nodes holding a hub for `namespace`.

operations.name: Fleet.installed_plugins
operations.doc: Every plugin package this controller loaded or refused at boot, and what its plugin root holds since.

operations.name: Fleet.provider
operations.doc: One plugin provider's help text, its plugin type and the hooks it supports.

operations.name: Fleet.providers
operations.doc: Every plugin provider this controller can enable, with its module and type, and how many plugin packages it refused at boot.

operations.name: Fleet.runner_caller_context
operations.doc: The caller context a runner in `namespace` connects with.

operations.name: Fleet.runners
operations.doc: Every runner serving `namespace`, anywhere in the cluster, each with the process id of the runner on its socket where the transport can say, so a user can tell which process a runner is.

operations.name: Fleet.runners_for_factory
operations.doc: The runners of one factory in `namespace`.

operations.name: Fleet.runners_on_this_node
operations.doc: The runners serving `namespace` **on this node only**.

operations.name: Namespace.bind_role
operations.doc: Bind `principal` to `role` in `namespace`, answering the identity's binding after it.

operations.name: Namespace.bootstrap
operations.doc: Claim the first admin with the one-time bootstrap token, answering the principal bound as `admin@_system` and, when one was minted for it, its token, shown this once.

operations.name: Namespace.create
operations.doc: Create the namespace `name`, with `opts[:quotas]` its ceilings that differ from the defaults.

args.name: opts
args.doc: `quotas`, the ceilings that differ from the defaults.

operations.name: Namespace.delete
operations.doc: Delete the namespace `name` and the quota counters keyed on it.

operations.name: Namespace.get
operations.doc: One namespace record.

operations.name: Namespace.issue_token
operations.doc: Issue a token for `principal` holding `role` in `namespace`, answering its id and the token itself, shown this once.

operations.name: Namespace.list
operations.doc: Every namespace record this controller holds.

operations.name: Namespace.list_roles
operations.doc: The role bindings the caller may see, one per identity: every binding for `admin@_system`, otherwise those of the caller's own namespace.

operations.name: Namespace.quota
operations.doc: One namespace's current count and ceiling for `kind`.

operations.name: Namespace.quota_kinds
operations.doc: The quota kinds a namespace can be given a ceiling for.

operations.name: Namespace.revoke_token
operations.doc: Revoke the token whose id starts with `token_id`.

args.name: token_id
args.doc: The token's id, or a prefix of it.

operations.name: Namespace.roles
operations.doc: The role bindings that reach `name`, including the ones bound cluster-wide.

args.name: name
args.doc: The namespace; every binding when absent.

operations.name: Namespace.set_quotas
operations.doc: Replace the namespace's quota overrides.

args.name: overrides
args.doc: The ceilings that differ from the defaults, by quota kind.

operations.name: Namespace.tokens
operations.doc: The tokens the caller may see, one row each: its id, principal, role, namespace, label and whether it is active, revoked or expired.

operations.name: Namespace.unbind_role
operations.doc: Unbind `role` from `principal`, or the principal's whole binding when `role` is absent or empty: the one-command revocation for an identity that is compromised or retired, which can only take rights away.

args.name: role
args.doc: The role; the whole binding when absent.

operations.name: Namespace.whoami
operations.doc: The identity the caller's credential resolves to.

operations.name: Observability.disable_source
operations.doc: Disable the source `name`.

operations.name: Observability.enable_source
operations.doc: Enable the source `name`.

operations.name: Observability.list_sinks
operations.doc: Every registered observability sink.

operations.name: Observability.list_sources
operations.doc: Every registered observability source and its status.

operations.name: Observability.query
operations.doc: The signals the ring buffer holds for `params.source`, in the caller's namespace.

operations.name: Observability.subscribe
operations.doc: Subscribe the calling process to the live signals of `source`.

operations.name: Observability.tail
operations.doc: Stream live signals for a single source to the caller process.

operations.name: Observability.unsubscribe
operations.doc: Undo a `subscribe/2` or `tail/2`.

operations.name: PluginManager.bind
operations.doc: Bind `fields[:relay_id]` to the plugin `name` with `:hooks` and `:channel`.

operations.name: PluginManager.disable
operations.doc: Disable the plugin `name`: every running copy stops, every binding stays.

operations.name: PluginManager.enable
operations.doc: Enable the plugin `name` built from `fields` (`:provider`, `:opts`, `:namespace`, `:single`, and `:relay_id`, `:hooks` and `:channel` to bind in the same call), answering how it was enabled and the controllers holding the namespace that lack its provider: the plugin does not run there.

operations.name: PluginManager.enabled
operations.doc: Every plugin enabled in `namespace`, as `list/1` answers for the caller's own.

operations.name: PluginManager.list
operations.doc: Every plugin enabled in the caller's namespace.

operations.name: PluginManager.unbind
operations.doc: Unbind `fields[:relay_id]` from the plugin `name`, which stays enabled.

operations.name: PluginManager.update
operations.doc: Change the plugin `name`'s options (`:opts`) and a controller plugin's `:hooks`, in place when every changed option is live, otherwise by restarting every running copy.

operations.name: Relay.call
operations.doc: Call `relay_id` with `message` and wait for its answer: the first output it caused on a sink, as `{:ok, payload, %{"channel" => channel}}`, or a coded error saying why none came.

args.name: channel
args.doc: The input channel; none when empty.

args.name: opts
args.doc: `deadline_ms`, `answer_channel` (the channel whose output answers), and `key` for a partition group.

operations.name: Relay.cell_state
operations.doc: A relay's live state, as JSON, and the change sequence it was read at.

operations.name: Relay.info
operations.doc: Every relay in `namespace` as its Overwatch reports it, every finished one still inside its retention window, and every partition group with its key-group coverage.

operations.name: Relay.list
operations.doc: The relays in `namespace`, one row each with its health, runner, node and, for a partition group, its width and members.

operations.name: Relay.list_namespaces
operations.doc: The namespaces in the durable catalog that the caller may be shown (its own, or all of them for an admin in `_system`), each with whether this controller runs a hub for it.

operations.name: Relay.list_relays
operations.doc: The relay ids running in `namespace`.

operations.name: Relay.listen
operations.doc: Hand every frame `relay_id` emits (with its parts and dead-letter notices), or ingests when `direction` is `input`, to the context's `:emit`, until the window closes, the caller goes away or the relay ends.

operations.name: Relay.overwatch_state
operations.doc: One relay's Overwatch state.

operations.name: Relay.partition_coverage
operations.doc: Partition coverage over `{id, range}` pairs: gaps, overlaps and total.

operations.name: Relay.partition_groups
operations.doc: The partition groups `rows` describe: group, declared width, members and key-group coverage.

operations.name: Relay.registry
operations.doc: The namespace's hub registry, as the hub reports it.

operations.name: Relay.relay_plugins
operations.doc: The plugin bindings each relay in `namespace` declares.

operations.name: Relay.relay_rows
operations.doc: One row per relay in `namespace`: node, health and partition.

operations.name: Relay.replay
operations.doc: Re-run a Cell's retained inputs from a point in the past through the current code: rewind the Cell to `from` (a WAL seq, or an ISO 8601 time), bump the epoch, and replay the input log forward, so a conforming keyed sink overwrites the stale rows by natural key.

args.name: from
args.doc: A WAL seq, or an ISO 8601 time.

operations.name: Relay.run_known?
operations.doc: Whether `run` is a way a relay runs that this controller knows.

operations.name: Relay.send
operations.doc: Inject `message` into `relay_id`'s input stream, blocking for the confirming verdict so a parked or absent target is reported rather than silently dropped.

args.name: channel
args.doc: The input channel; none when empty.

args.name: opts
args.doc: `key`, for a partition group, and `msg_id`, the message's id.

operations.name: Relay.start
operations.doc: Start `relay` in `namespace`, answering the id it runs under and whether this call started it (`:started`) or found a live instance already holding the id it named (`:already_running`).

operations.name: Relay.stop
operations.doc: Stop `relay_id` in `namespace`, or every member of the partition group it names.

operations.name: Schedule.add
operations.doc: Store a schedule from `fields` (`name`, `cron`, `timezone`, `factory_id`, `namespace`, `init_values`, `text`, `channel`, `plugins`) and assert it on the hub, so it starts firing.

operations.name: Schedule.assert_entry
operations.doc: Assert `entry` on the hub, so it starts firing.

operations.name: Schedule.list
operations.doc: Every stored schedule, by name, each with what the hub holds for it: the node that fires it, its last fire and that fire's result, and when it fires next, in UTC.

operations.name: Schedule.next_fire
operations.doc: The next UTC instant a parsed cron fires after `after_utc`, in `tz`.

operations.name: Schedule.parse_cron
operations.doc: Parse a cron expression, or say why it cannot be parsed.

operations.name: Schedule.remove
operations.doc: Forget the schedule `name` and retract it from the hub, so it stops firing.

operations.name: Schedule.retract
operations.doc: Retract the schedule `name` from the hub, so it stops firing.

operations.name: Schedule.run
operations.doc: Fire the schedule `name` once, now, judged as a start where its instance starts.

operations.name: Schedule.statuses
operations.doc: What the hub currently holds for each schedule.

operations.name: Steps.cells
operations.doc: One row per Cell of `relay_class` with persisted state: its WAL and snapshot sequences, WAL size and the writer's counters.

operations.name: Steps.committed_iterations
operations.doc: The iterations the instance's journal has committed.

operations.name: Steps.completed_retention_hours
operations.doc: How long a completed instance of `relay_class` is retained, in hours.

operations.name: Steps.completion
operations.doc: One steps instance's completion record.

operations.name: Steps.consumed_offset
operations.doc: The input-log offset the instance's last iteration consumed, `nil` for none.

operations.name: Steps.delete
operations.doc: Hard-delete one Cell's persisted state: WAL, snapshots and outbox dedup.

operations.name: Steps.inbox
operations.doc: An instance's durable input log, for a flow relay on the effectively-once tier and a durable steps relay alike: every retained record with its offset, whether it is at or below the instance's floor (consumed), its size and channel.

operations.name: Steps.journal
operations.doc: One instance's task journal in append order, the leaf tasklets that define "done" for it, and whether the in-flight iteration has committed every leaf.

operations.name: Steps.last_offset
operations.doc: The last offset written to the instance's input log, `-1` when it has none.

operations.name: Steps.outbox
operations.doc: One Cell's outbox: durable seq, flush cursor, epoch, undispatched lag, the entries a steps Cell holds until its stage commits, and the relay's input-log min-watermark.

operations.name: Steps.relay_classes
operations.doc: Every relay class this controller holds persisted state for.

operations.name: Steps.rescale
operations.doc: Rescale the partition group `group_id` in `namespace` to `target`.

operations.name: Steps.rewind
operations.doc: Rewind `relay_class` in `namespace` to the committed iteration `to_iter`.

args.name: to_iter
args.doc: The committed iteration to rewind to.

operations.name: Steps.rotate
operations.doc: Force a compaction of one Cell by dispatching a `CompactCell` to its runner.

operations.name: Steps.set_retention
operations.doc: Retain `relay_class`'s write-ahead history for `hours`, in this controller's memory: it lasts until the next boot unless the runtime configuration says so too.

operations.name: Steps.state_get
operations.doc: The CURRENT in-memory state of one live Cell, or of one tasklet's Cells, as JSON, with the change sequence it was read at.

operations.name: Steps.state_metrics
operations.doc: Durable-state counters across every relay class.

operations.name: Steps.time_travel
operations.doc: One Cell's state as of `target` (a WAL seq, or an ISO 8601 time), replayed from its write-ahead log: the seq it resolves to, and the snapshot and change log bytes behind it.

args.name: target
args.doc: A WAL seq, or an ISO 8601 time.

operations.name: Steps.undelivered
operations.doc: The input-log records above the instance's floor: what it has not consumed yet.
